svg.title: Six domains of executable task families
svg.desc: 35 families, 408 executable cases. Systems 10 families / 97 cases; Services 5 / 67; Data Processing 6 / 78; Scientific Computing 4 / 55; Finance 5 / 63; Office Automation 5 / 48. Counts include learning anchors. Each row gives one representative task type.

g.aria-label: Right: families / cases, including learning anchors.
